content:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot in bullish sentiment phases.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is weak or negative; model fails to adjust downward in low sentiment.
- Lag in correction: model often delays downward revisions after strong upward moves, especially when sentiment is positive.
- Mean reversion bias: model overreacts to short-term volatility, underestimating sustained upward trends in strong sentiment.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are overly optimistic in early periods with rising sentiment; later periods show underestimation of peak prices.
- Sentiment-weighted adjustment: if sentiment > 0.3, reduce forecast by 2–5% to account for overconfidence; if sentiment < 0.1, increase forecast by 3–7% to compensate for underreaction.
